subject: Usage true-up, proposed courtesy credit & TDS evidence request
messages:
From: Aisha Thomas <aisha.thomas@lunarhealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance Team <finance@lunarhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice LN-4512 + usage true-up / tax docs

Hi Nikhil,

We completed our review of October consumption and noticed an unexpected surge that produced invoice LN-4512 for $18,924. Per our contract this looks like a legitimate over-usage charge but given our onboarding spike we were hoping Redwood could consider a one-time goodwill concession (partial credit) while we finalize quota tuning.

To process any credit and release funds on our side we need:
- A credit memo referencing LN-4512
- Formal confirmation of the credit amount and whether it will be applied to our next invoice or issued as a refund
- TDS (withholding tax) evidence for Redwood (required by our AP before they release net payment)

Can you confirm next steps and an estimated timeline? We can share a scanned TIN/TDS form if needed.

Appreciate the help — we want to keep momentum on the integration.

Thanks,
Aisha
Aisha Thomas
Finance Manager, Lunar Health
attachments: none
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Thomas <aisha.thomas@lunarhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice LN-4512 + usage true-up / tax docs

Hi Aisha — thanks for flagging and the context.

We can offer a one-time courtesy credit to help smooth the onboarding spike while you tune the quotas. Proposal: issue a credit memo of $6,000 (approx. 32% of LN-4512) applied to the next invoice, and hold off any collections actions on the outstanding balance until we receive TDS evidence from your team.

Action items for Lunar Health:
- Send TDS/withholding certificate (PDF) or confirm your AP contact for a direct handoff
- Confirm you accept the proposed $6,000 credit applied to the next bill OR request a refund to bank details (refunds require additional processing time)

I'll draft the credit memo once you confirm. If you need manager approval for a larger concession, I've looped in Laura and Sean.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: none
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Invoice LN-4512 + usage true-up / tax docs

Forwarding for approval — I reviewed Nikhil's recommendation and authorize a courtesy credit of $6,000 applied as a credit memo (next invoice). Please proceed with the following:

- Collections: place a temporary hold on follow-up reminders for LN-4512 until 11/15/2026 provided Lunar shares TDS evidence by 11/09/2026.
- Finance Ops: issue credit memo (proposed-credit-memo-4512.pdf) referencing DL-1987 and LN-4512; include note that credit is non-refundable unless otherwise requested in writing.
- Integrations/Account team: update the account notes in HubSpot and enable quota smoothing recommendations in the Console.

Nikhil/Laura — confirm when the credit memo is uploaded and I'll sign off the exception.

Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: proposed-credit-memo-4512.pdf
From: Aisha Thomas <aisha.thomas@lunarhealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance Team <finance@lunarhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice LN-4512 + usage true-up / tax docs

Nikhil / Marissa — thanks, that works. Lunar Health accepts the $6,000 credit applied to the next invoice. AP will send the TDS withholding certificate (scanned PDF) by EOD Monday 11/09/2026.

Please proceed with issuing the credit memo to allow our team to update the ledger and complete the payment net of the credit. If you need our bank details for a refund option in the future, I can provide them, but for now we prefer credit on account.

I'll attach the TDS doc when we have it.

Regards,
Aisha
attachments: requested-tds-certificate.pdf
